intro_html: Turns product classification into a system your production and sales history can actually trust: reclassify a product any time, and while its bill of materials updates immediately, every already-confirmed sale order line and manufacturing order keeps the classification it had the moment it was confirmed — so past documents never quietly change meaning.

features.title: Hierarchical Kind Catalog
features.desc: A draggable multi-level tree with List, Kanban and Form views, plus route type and manufacturing mode per kind.

features.title: Different From Product Category
features.desc: Odoo's built-in Category is accounting-focused and offers no history protection. Product Kind is production-focused, and freezes onto confirmed documents instead of rewriting history.

features.title: Live Product Link
features.desc: Products and bills of materials always reflect a kind's current classification — reclassify anytime and everything downstream updates immediately.

features.title: Frozen Sale & MO Snapshots
features.desc: Confirming a sale order or creating a manufacturing order freezes the kind at that moment, so history never silently changes.

features.title: Manager-Only Snapshot Edits
features.desc: Once frozen, only a Product Kind Manager can correct a snapshot — enforced at the model level, even against direct API or import writes.

features.title: Subtree Smart Buttons
features.desc: Jump from any kind to the Products, BoMs, Sale Lines and Manufacturing Orders across its entire subtree, counts included.

features.title: Snapshot-Aware Reporting
features.desc: Sales Analysis groups by Product Kind and Route Type using the same snapshot-first, live-fallback rule as the rest of the module.

features.title: Safe Archiving & Deletion
features.desc: A kind can't be archived while active sub-kinds exist, and only a leaf kind can be deleted — no accidental subtree wipeouts.

limitations: The manufacturing-order snapshot inherits from a sale order line only if your installation links MOs to sale lines; otherwise every MO snapshots the product's current kind at creation.
The manufacturing-mode field records intent for reporting and automation — it doesn't itself alter Odoo's procurement routes.
Smart-button counters are computed on read (not stored) and reflect the current database state each time the form is opened.
